shared_elements: carved relief on an upright slab/stela form
incised linear detail across the whole surface
justification: Both are upright rounded-topped monuments covered with incised relief and both include anthropomorphic content and a circular disc/rosette element, but A depicts a flat multi-register narrative of seated and kneeling profile figures with rows of script and a winged disc lunette, while B is a single frontal figure carved in the round with a headdress, pendant necklace ornaments and a central disc on the chest. The organizing schemes differ fundamentally — horizontal registers of small profile figures versus one monolithic body-shaped figure with attributes distributed anatomically — so only the most generic correspondences hold.
